purpose: Fixes the bytes of the decision rules, the arm specification, the protocol, and the code that applies them, so that the branch reported after the run can be re-derived from the rules as they stood before it.
scope_note: This document establishes internal consistency only. It cannot show that the files are old, nor that a sealed file and this manifest were not edited together. The external half is the deposit, which publishes a per-file checksum that anyone can read without an account.
self_hash_canonicalisation: sha256 of json.dumps(manifest_without_self_sha256, sort_keys=True, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoded as UTF-8
